title: Drawer grids: Total receipt
summary: For each row of drawers, produce the sum of that row. Empty rows contribute 0. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
The supply cabinet has uneven rows of drawers, including a few rows left entirely empty. Ivo is closing the print-room account before the afternoon mail. A single total must replace the pile of working slips.

For each row of drawers, produce the sum of that row. Empty rows contribute 0.

Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement drawerGridsTotalReceipt(drawers, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Nested array traversal. For each row of drawers, produce the sum of that row. Empty rows contribute 0. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys (earlier units are used while the first two levels establish the foundations).
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with nested array traversal. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
For each row of drawers, produce the sum of that row. Empty rows contribute 0. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [12,0,12,-2,22]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 44.
The derived sequence is [6,0,-6,6]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 6.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.

overview: Variation: Nested array traversal. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
